messages:
Sasha K: Heads-up — preflight for release v2.3.0 is queued. DeployBot just published the eval summary. Can we do a quick QA + release notes sanity check before the change window?
DeployBot: preflight report: https://artifacts.internal/release/v2.3.0/preflight.pdf. Eval-gate: 6/8 suites passed. Summarizer prompt-set shows delta: +1.8% hallucination rate (threshold 1.5%). Latency +4% (within SLA).
Ryan M: Thanks. +1.8% on hallucination is above the threshold — do we have the breakdown by prompt category?
DeployBot: breakdown: short-summaries +0.3%, long-summaries +3.4% (driven by tail-case: multi-topic docs). See table in report.
Maria P: Product here — long-summaries degradation is concerning. Is it a quality regression vs v2.2?
Chen L: I ran a 200-sample diff between v2.2 and v2.3 on the long-summary set. v2.3 has more concise outputs but ~3.2% more hallucinations on that subset. Might be from decoder temp/beam changes in model compile.
Sasha K: Proposal: do a controlled regional rollout with a stricter canary for summarizer-heavy routes. US region 10% traffic for 45m with synthetic prompt-set running in parallel. EU region stays pinned to v2.2 until we triage. If canary fails, immediate rollback.
QA-Bot: Canary guardrails: require (1) synthetic pass rate >= 98% for the long-summary set, (2) aggregate hallucination delta <= 1.0% vs v2.2, (3) latency within +7% and no 95th-percentile spikes.
Ryan M: Sounds reasonable. Who signs the QA pass? I can review infra/latency. Maria — can you own the product/quality signoff?
Maria P: I can sign if we get a reduced fail-case list and a proposed mitigation (prompt nudge or post-filter). Also want release notes updated mentioning the known long-summary regression and the rollback plan.
Chen L: Immediate mitigation I can try: enable conservative beam fallback for long-summary route and run quick eval. If that reduces hallucination to under 1% delta, we proceed. If not, we keep EU pinned and only rollout US to 5% instead of 10%.
Sasha K: Change window: tomorrow 2026-03-21 22:00 UTC. Timeline: 22:00 start, 22:00–22:45 canary, 22:45 decision, 23:00 gradual ramp or rollback. Please confirm availability.
Oncall Pager: I'll be on-call and watching infra alerts. Pager escalation page: #oncall.
Maria P: I'll be available for signoff at 22:40 UTC. Ryan will watch metrics. Chen — can you get the conservative-beam eval by EOD today?
Chen L: On it. Running local sweep now, will post results here.
DeployBot: NOTE: To pin older behavior for EU region, run: `deployctl set-route --region=eu --model=v2.2 --duration=patch` — will create a temporary pin ticket in releases board.
Sasha K: Release notes draft (please copy into release doc):
```
v2.3.0 - Inference runtime and model compilation improvements
- Improvements: reduced tokenization overhead, lower avg latency on chat routes
- Known issue: slight regression in long-summary prompt set resulting in higher hallucination rate for some multi-topic documents. We are performing a limited canary and conservative fallback during rollout. EU region will stay pinned to v2.2 until triage completes. See rollback instructions in the runbook.
```
Ryan M: Looks good. Add the Canary guardrails and the exact rollback step (mentioned by DeployBot).
Maria P: After Chen posts the fallback eval, if numbers look good I'll +1. Otherwise we keep EU pinned and reduce US canary to 5% and extend monitoring to 90m.
Chen L: Quick results: conservative beam reduces long-summary hallucination delta to +0.6% and keeps latency at +5%. Posting full csv: https://artifacts.internal/ci/beam-sweep.csv
Ryan M: That meets QA-Bot thresholds. I'm +1 on infra/latency.
QA-Bot: Synthetic pass: 99.1% long-summary, hallucination delta +0.6% vs v2.2, latency +5% (95th stable). Guards satisfied.
Maria P: +1 product. Sasha — you have two LGTMs. Proceed with US 10% canary as planned. EU pinned to v2.2.
Sasha K: Great — final checklist: (1) update release notes doc with the snippet above (Maria), (2) run DeployBot pin for EU (DeployBot/Chen), (3) start canary 22:00 UTC (DeployBot), (4) monitor QA-Bot dashboard and be ready to rollback to v2.2 using `deployctl rollback --model=v2.2 --all-routes` if triggered.
DeployBot: Actions queued: create pin ticket (#REL-458), schedule canary at 2026-03-21T22:00:00Z, notify on alerts to #eng-releases and #oncall.
Oncall Pager: Acknowledged — will escalate on threshold breaches.
Sasha K: Thanks team. I'll publish a short release note in the changelog and close this thread once canary completes.
Maria P: Thanks — please capture any end-of-canary notes in the ticket.
Chen L: I'll standby for rollback if needed.
DeployBot: Canary started: 2026-03-21T22:00:00Z (will post progress).
